finding.title: Cancelling a hold may leave an authorized deposit uncaptured and unreleased
finding.explanation: cancelHold refunds a captured deposit, but an authorized one that was never captured is neither voided nor released, so the guest's card may show a pending charge for days.
finding.reasoningSummary: Whether the payment provider voids an uncaptured authorization on its own depends on the account's settings, which the reviewer can't read. It reported the finding again without verifying it.
